title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Ninghai 29.28917N 121.42472E, 13–15 November 2015–2025
claims: Across 33 days of 13–15 November from 2015 to 2025 at the Ninghai grid point, daily maximum temperature ranged 12.7–23.5°C with a median of 18.9°C.
Daily minimum temperature ranged 3.9–19.3°C with a median of 11.9°C.
13 of the 33 days had at least 1 mm precipitation and 8 had at least 5 mm.

claimVerification.note: 脚本读取 daily.temperature_2m_max 的 33 个值，最小值 12.7、最大值 23.5、中位数 18.9。
